facts.about: KPIT is a global technology company with software solutions that will help mobility leapfrog towards autonomous, clean, smart and connected future. With 13000+ Automobelievers across the globe, specializing in embedded software, AI & Digital solutions, KPIT enables customers accelerate implementation of next generation mobility technologies . With development centers in Europe, USA, Japan, China, Thailand and India

flags.text: Cash-rich profits: 5-yr operating cash = 165% of PAT
Latest quarter growth (+6%) well below 3-yr trend (+24%)

business.summary: KPIT Technologies Ltd. provides embedded software and integration solutions for the automotive and mobility ecosystem, helping clients build clean, smart, and safe software-defined vehicles. It generates revenue through engineering services, solutions, and product licensing models.

guidance.statement: H2 will be better than H1
guidance.quote: So, I think we have mentioned last time that H2 will be better than H1. I think we will maintain that.

guidance.statement: H2 will be better than H1, and we will return to growth in H2 by Q4
guidance.quote: During the outlook, we have just mentioned that H2 will be better than H1, and we will return to growth in H2 by Q4, driven by the Q4 performance

guidance.statement: Expect 30% year-on-year revenue growth in solution and products.
guidance.quote: We expect 30% year-on-year revenue growth in solution and products, and we hope it will increase over the period.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin expected between 20.5% to 21.2% for FY27.
guidance.quote: EBITDA 20.5 to 21.2 post increasing investment in AI solutions and products competency development and new markets.

guidance.statement: Target 50% revenue share from solutions and product in the medium term.
guidance.quote: 50% revenue share to be achieved from solutions and product.

guidance.statement: Expect EBITDA to be between 22% to 24% in the medium term.
guidance.quote: So we expect the EBITDA to be between 22% to 24% from where we are today.

guidance.statement: Q4 revenue growth will be the highest quarterly growth in FY26.
guidance.quote: One is, we believe that in the last quarter that is Q4, we will improve, our growth will be higher, it will be the highest quarterly growth in FY26.

guidance.statement: Profitability will improve in Q4 compared to Q3 in spite of investments.
guidance.quote: And our profitability will improve from what we have in Q3 in spite of our investments.

guidance.statement: The company will for sure grow next year higher than this year.
guidance.quote: The second thing is, we feel reasonably, I mean, and please recognize that we will tell you at end of Q4, but I am just giving you my feel right now. We will for sure grow next year higher than this year.

guidance.statement: It may take 12 to 18 months for a large part of our business to convert into solutions.
guidance.quote: We do believe that this may take 12 months to 18 months, for a large part of our business to convert into this

scorecard.promised: EBITDA margin expected between 20.5% to 21.2% for FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Reported 15% in Q1 and 16% in Q2 FY27.
scorecard.evidence: Margins have dropped significantly from the 21% peak in FY25 to 16% in the most recent quarter.

scorecard.promised: H2 will be better than H1, returning to growth by Q4 FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Q2 FY27 revenue grew 1% sequentially to ₹1,691 crore.
scorecard.evidence: H1 FY27 revenue totals ₹3,366 crore; H2 must exceed this to meet the 'better than H1' guidance.

scorecard.promised: Expect 30% year-on-year revenue growth in solution and products.
scorecard.delivered: Products revenue grew 25% year-on-year in Q2 FY27.
scorecard.evidence: While 25% growth is strong, it currently trails the 30% annual target set for the fiscal year.

scorecard.promised: Expect EBITDA to be between 22% to 24% in the medium term.
scorecard.delivered: Operating margin fell to 19% in FY26 and 16% in Q2 FY27.
scorecard.evidence: Current margins are trending away from the 22-24% target, dropping 500 bps below the lower bound.

scorecard.promised: The company will for sure grow next year higher than this year.
scorecard.delivered: Q2 FY27 YoY growth was 6.5% vs 9.4% in Q3 FY26.
scorecard.evidence: Growth has decelerated from 12% in Mar 2026 to 6.5% in Sep 2026, requiring a sharp H2 recovery.

narrative.scoreline: Management is struggling to defend premium margin targets as operational reality shifts toward lower-margin fixed-price work and decelerating top-line growth.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: EBITDA margin improved due to higher product contributions.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Margins improved 60 bps sequentially in Q2 but remain 500 bps lower than the prior year peak.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Commercial vehicle segment will return to growth in the next quarter.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Off-highway and commercial grew 17.6% sequentially in Q2 FY27.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Profitability will improve in Q4 FY26 compared to Q3 FY26.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Operating margins actually fell from 19% in Dec 2025 to 18% in Mar 2026.

bull: Strong cash generation with 5-year operating cash flow reaching 165% of PAT.
Commercial vehicle segment shows resilience with 27% year-on-year growth in the latest quarter.
Successful transition to fixed-price projects, now accounting for 70% of the business mix.
bear: Operating margins have collapsed from 21% in FY25 to 16% in the most recent quarter.
Revenue growth has slowed to 6.5% YoY, significantly below the 3-year average of 24%.
Net profit for FY26 fell to ₹637 crore from ₹840 crore the previous year.
watch: Q4 FY27 revenue growth rate to verify the promised return to high-growth trajectory.

claims.claim: Overall revenue growth has been 6.5% year-on-year and 1% sequentially in rupee terms.
claims.quote: So, overall growth has been 6.5% year-on-year and 1%, in terms of quarter-on-quarter, in rupee terms.

claims.claim: Off-highway and commercial segment has grown 27% year-on-year and 17.6% quarter-on-quarter.
claims.quote: off highway and Commercial has grown 27% year-on-year and 17.6% quarter-on-quarter.

claims.claim: Products revenue grew 5% quarter-on-quarter and 25% year-on-year.
claims.quote: This we have a 5% growth quarter-on-quarter during the quarter and 25% year-on-year.

claims.claim: EBITDA margin improved by 60 bps to 17.8% due to higher product contributions.
claims.quote: our EBITDA has grown from 17.2% to 17.8%, this is 60 basis point, largely it is because of the business mix as the products contributions are higher

claims.claim: Fixed price projects increased to about 70%.
claims.quote: The fixed price projects have moved to about 70%, which is significant.

claims.claim: Profitability will return largely when revenues come, and margins will improve incrementally until then.
claims.quote: the margins will improve, but it will improve incrementally, not significantly until our revenues go back to growing ways.

claims.claim: Commercial vehicle segment will return to growth in the next quarter.
claims.quote: On the commercial vehicle, we will be on for growth next quarter.

claims.claim: Qorix loss will continue for at least the next quarter or two.
claims.quote: the Qorix loss, which we said, I think it will continue for at least next quarter or two that we believe thats how it will be.

claims.claim: Cash stood at 9.6 billion at the quarter end with a final dividend of 5.25 per share.
claims.quote: dividend payout after dividend payout, it is 9.6 billion cash at the quarter end, and we have the final dividend, which is 5.25 per share.

claims.claim: More than 80% of new contracts are fixed price in nature.
claims.quote: More than 80% of our new contracts are fixed price in nature.

claims.claim: Added 13 clients across the three segments during the year.
claims.quote: Unlike any other year in the past, we added 13 clients.

claims.claim: FY26 year-on-year growth was 9.4% in rupee terms, 3% in US dollar terms, and Q3 constant currency growth was 1.5%.
claims.quote: So, FY’26 year-on-year growth was 9.4% in rupee terms, 3% in US Dollar terms , and the constant currency growth in Quarter 3 was 1.5%.

claims.claim: Cash at quarter end is INR 9 billion after paying INR 6.3 billion for Caresoft and N-Dream.
claims.quote: The cash at the end of the quarter is about INR 9 billion after payment of INR 6.3 billion against the payouts of Caresoft and N-Dream during the quarter.

claims.claim: The TCV value of deals won during the quarter is INR 202 million across Europe, USA, and China.
claims.quote: The TCV value of deals won during the quarter is INR 202 million. Largely it is across the geographies, Europe the highest, followed by USA and there is also something from China, this quarter - from a Chinese OEM.

claims.claim: The net profit excluding the one-time Labor Code impact is 1.53 billion, while the Labor Code impact was INR 469 million.
claims.quote: Overall, the net profit excluding the one-time Labor Code impact is 1.53 billion against 1.53 billion last quarter. The impact of new labour code,was INR 469 million post-tax.

risks.text: Disruption in mobility industry and passenger car segment concentration can impact growth and profitability.
Technology changes and emergence of disruptive technologies like AI can create business model disruptions.
Inability to attract and retain top talent with competence in new technology areas including AI.
Major currency fluctuations have an impact on company financial results.
